experiment.details: Single-spectrum core-loss EELS at T=400 K; energy axis 350–862 eV across 2048 channels; integration time 20 s; dark subtracted.

sample.description: Synthetic strontium titanate EELS test data. Expected core-loss edges in this energy window: Ti L2,3 (~456 eV) and O K (~530 eV). Sr edges are out of range (Sr L2,3 at ~1940 eV; Sr M4,5 at ~133 eV) — useful to know in identification mode, since the spectrum cannot directly distinguish SrTiO3 from TiO2 polymorphs from these edges alone. This particular spectrum deliberately contains an extra Ti3+ contamination shoulder at ~453.5 eV that a clean Ti4+-only model will not capture.

title: Synthetic SrTiO3 EELS spectrum with Ti3+ contamination (T=400 K)
